import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(8, 8), dpi=120)
fig.subplots_adjust(wspace=0, hspace=0)

# Set the suptitle
fig.suptitle('Four Functions on a Shared Domain', fontsize=14)

axs[0, 0].plot(x, x, color='blue', linestyle='-', marker='o', label='y=x')

axs[0, 0].grid(linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[0, 0].legend(loc='upper left')
axs[0, 0].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axs[0, 0].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Plot y = x^2 in the top-right
axs[0, 1].plot(x, x**2, color='red', linestyle='--', marker='s', label='y=x²')
axs[0, 1].set_title('Quadratic')
axs[0, 1].grid(linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[0, 1].legend(loc='upper left')
axs[0, 1].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axs[0, 1].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Plot y = x^3 in the bottom-left
axs[1, 0].plot(x, x**3, color='green', linestyle=':', marker='^', label='y=x³')
axs[1, 0].set_title('Cubic')
axs[1, 0].set_ylabel('f(x)')
axs[1, 0].set_xlabel('x')
axs[1, 0].grid(linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[1, 0].legend(loc='upper left')
axs[1, 0].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axs[1, 0].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Plot y = abs(x) in the bottom-right
axs[1, 1].plot(x, np.abs(x), color='purple', linestyle='-.', marker='D', label='y=|x|')
axs[1, 1].set_title('Absolute')
axs[1, 1].set_xlabel('x')
axs[1, 1].grid(linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
axs[1, 1].legend(loc='upper left')
axs[1, 1].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axs[1, 1].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Share the x-axis for all plots
for ax in axs.flat:
    ax.get_shared_x_axes().join(ax, axs[0, 0])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
EOF"}

plt.savefig('figure.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
